title: Background track for video
description: An instrumental music prompt that stays under dialogue: defined tempo, instrumentation, structure and mix, for Suno, Udio and similar tools.

variables.name: use_case
variables.example: a 90-second SaaS product walkthrough with voice-over

variables.name: genre
variables.example: lo-fi electronic with light organic percussion

template:
Instrumental {{genre}} track for {{use_case}}. Mood: {{mood}}. Tempo {{tempo_bpm}} BPM, steady and consistent throughout.

Instrumentation: soft rhythmic foundation, warm bass, one simple melodic motif on a mellow lead; no vocals, no vocal chops, no spoken samples.
Structure: 4-bar gentle intro, main groove that repeats with small variations every 8 bars so it can be looped or cut anywhere, a slight lift in the middle section, and a clean 2-bar resolved ending.
Mix: sit under a voice-over, mids kept clear between 1-4 kHz, no sudden drops, no loud risers, no hard stops, even dynamics.

Avoid: lyrics, dramatic build-ups, dissonant or distracting solos, genre switches mid-track.

example.use_case: a 90-second SaaS product walkthrough with voice-over
example.genre: lo-fi electronic with light organic percussion
